description: Manage the unified cross-network social and messaging inbox across LinkedIn, X DMs, Instagram, Threads, Telegram, and WhatsApp. Supports listing conversation threads (`list_threads`), reading full message history in a thread (`read_thread`), dispatching outbound replies (`reply`), and marking threads as read (`mark_read`). Returns normalized conversation objects with sender handles, timestamps, direction (`inbound`/`outbound`), and delivery confirmation.

action.description: Inbox operation: 'list_threads' returns recent DM conversations, 'read_thread' fetches all messages in `threadId`, 'reply' sends a direct message response, and 'mark_read' clears unread flags.

cooldownHours.description: Per-contact cooldown window in hours before re-triggering the workflow.

edges.description: Graph directed edges (`{ from, to, condition }`) connecting workflow nodes.

nodes.description: Graph nodes array (`trigger`, `send_message`, `wait_for_reply`, `condition`, `hubspot_upsert_contact`, `handoff`, `end`) when creating an inbox workflow.

platform.description: Optional social or messaging platform filter (e.g. 'linkedin', 'x', 'instagram', 'telegram', 'whatsapp').

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (`prof_...`) whose unified inbox should be queried or replied from.

replyBody.description: Text body of the outbound direct message reply when `action` is 'reply'. Required for 'reply'.

threadId.description: Conversation thread identifier (`thr_...`). Required when `action` is 'reply' and optional target for 'read_thread' or 'mark_read'.

triggerPayload.description: Simulated or live event payload (`{ contact, message, replyText, event }`) when `action` is 'trigger_workflow'.

unreadOnly.description: When true, filters `list_threads` to return only unread inbound conversations requiring agent or human attention.

workflowId.description: Workflow identifier (`wf_...`) when getting, activating, pausing, triggering, or deleting an inbox automation workflow graph.

name: inbox_messages
title: Unified Social & Messaging Inbox
